title: Reflected XSS through direct echo in an Extbase controller
root_cause: The controller writes a request-supplied value into the response body using echo. Fluid's default output escaping never runs, so markup contained in the value is reflected into the rendered page.

origin.note: The XSS advisory in the local knowledge store (TYPO3-PSA-2024-003) carries no source link and is a synthetic seed. This pair documents the contract of RawFluidOrEchoXssRule instead.
